Name: Oho Davi Style Topless Portraits - Addon for Nude Girls and Valley Girls
Author: TwistedSquiddy
Description:
This mod replaces Abigail and Haley’s portraits with stylized topless versions inspired by the anime art of [i]Oho Davi[/i]. The art keeps the expressive style of the anime girls while adding a more sexual touch. This is an [b]addon[/b] for the [b]Nude Girls[/b] mod by [i]trashracc1124[/i] and requires it to function properly.
Currently includes:
[list]
[*]Abigail (topless)
[*]Haley (topless)
[*]Emily (topless)
[*]Penny (topless)
[*]Leah (topless)
[*]Maru (topless)
[*]Caroline (topless)
[*]Robin (topless)
[/list]More characters and variants will be added in future updates.
[b]Note:[/b] This mod is intended for mature audiences. Make sure to install it in a responsible manner.

THIS MOD IS MANUAL

There will be two folders: One containing all of the pierced sprites and one with all of the non-pierced. Simply drag one of the character folders from either into your "[CP] Nude Girls/assets/Portraits" folder and voila!

If using vortex it will prompt you about a new file, choose to keep the new file.

Note: This mod is also compatible with [b]Valley Girls[/b] by [i]trashracc1124[/i], it just requires you to move the {character_name}.png file from this mod's {character_name} folder into "[CP] Valley Girls/assets/Portraits" instead.

For example if you would want to replace Abigail in Valley Girls sex cutscenes, you'd take the file from

"Ohodavi Topless Portraits/Pierced/Abigail/Abigail.png"

and drag it into the folder 

"[CP] Valley Girls/assets/Portraits"
